summary: Track, analyze, and learn from competitors’ ads with GetCrux: AI that transforms ad libraries into actionable creative intelligence.

## Analyze Competitor Ads Across Meta, TikTok, Google, and YouTube


GetCrux is a competitor ad analysis tool that captures and analyzes competitor ads across **social, video,** and **display channels** .


Instead of manually browsing ad libraries, teams can automatically track:


-


Active and historical competitor ads


-


Messaging angles and hooks


-


Creative formats and structures


-


Landing pages and conversion flows


-


Campaign timelines and refresh cycles


This turns competitor ad activity into structured, actionable data.


‍


## Ad Spy Tool to Track Competitor Ad Creatives


**GetCrux** functions as an[ad spy tool](https://www.getcrux.ai/) that continuously monitors competitor creatives across platforms.


Teams can:


-


See what ads competitors are currently running


-


Access historical creatives and past campaigns


-


Track how creatives evolve over time


-


Identify which concepts are being scaled


[Competitor ad tracking](https://www.getcrux.ai/) becomes automated and comprehensive.

## Analyze Competitor Ad Creatives (Hooks, Scenes, Messaging, CTAs)


Each competitor ad is automatically broken down into structured components:


-

-


Messaging angle (pricing, urgency, benefit, trust)


-


Emotional tone and narrative style


-


Scene type (UGC, product demo, lifestyle, studio)


-


Visual structure and pacing


-


CTA format and placement


Teams can analyze:


-


Which creative structures competitors rely on


-


How top-performing ads are constructed


-


What patterns repeat across campaigns
